_note: TOOLS LIST — is file ko edit karke aap khud tools add/edit kar sakte ho. Naya tool: neeche 'tools' mein ek naya { ... } block add karo. Fields: name (naam), base (aapki cost PKR — is par 15% khud lag jayega), stock (adad ya null), cat (AI, Video, Design, VPN, Productivity, Hosting, Streaming, Course, Accounts mein se ek), override (agar fixed selling price chahiye to ye likho, warna hata do), deal (true = Limited Deal badge + purani price), wasBase (deal wali purani cost). Edit karke is file ko Hostinger par index.html ke SAATH dobara upload karo — bas!
